resolution.summary: Added persistent local project favorites with accessible star toggles, a Favorites-only directory filter and favorite-first project ordering. Choices apply to Git families and linked worktrees, survive catalog/runtime-cache rebuilds, and use serialized private preferences protected by session tokens, origin checks and registered IDs. Corrupt preferences never block project registration. Browser/package checks passed; installed 0.4.3 locally and reloaded the open dashboard to show the controls.
